name: AIdol
summary: Billed as Russia's first AI-driven anthropomorphic robot, built over several years by a self-funded team of fourteen with roughly 77% domestically made parts. Its face is silicone over 19 servomotors, covering a dozen basic emotions and hundreds of micro-expressions, and a GPU module runs perception and dialogue offline. Its live debut is best remembered for the robot falling flat on stage.
notable: Fell over during its live debut, in October 2025
Runs perception and dialogue fully offline
